thread:
anne-partnerships: Quick check — we need staging creds + one demo seat for the Snowflake + Databricks + Qdrant connector trial next week. Also want to run an embeddings sanity test and exercise the burst policy (simulate ~2k req/min for 5m). Can eng provision and share creds?

mike-eng: Yep. Which env do you want — ai-staging or partner-sandbox?

anne-partnerships: partner-sandbox please. Need a service account with limited scope: read/write to staging schema, no production access. Also one UI demo seat.

tina-soleng: FYI our test script will ingest ~1k short docs, batch size 64, and then run an end-to-end search against Qdrant. We need to confirm token billing is visible per-route.

mike-eng: Got it. I'll create a service account and a scoped API key. I'll put creds in a secure 1:1 and paste a short sanity curl here for you to run:```bash
curl -s -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-medium","input":["hello world"]}'
```
This should return a small vector and usage meta.

raj-snowflake: I can validate the Snowflake side. Make sure the stage has EXTERNAL TABLE and STORAGE INTEGRATION privileges. Send me the role name once it's created.

mike-eng: Role = partner_connector_demo_role. I'll grant USAGE on database/schema and create a restricted user.

anne-partnerships: For the burst policy, can we configure automatic fallback to a lower-cost model when sustained peak is detected? We want graceful degradation rather than hard 429s.

mike-eng: Yes — we can set a route policy. Example config blob (will be applied to partner-sandbox route):```json
{"peak_rps":2000, "peak_window_sec":300, "fallback_model":"redwood-small", "cooldown_sec":600, "circuit_breaker_pct":0.95}
```
That will route excess traffic to fallback_model and open circuit if errors spike.

tina-soleng: Perfect. Also request telemetry labels: partner_id=acme_data, test_run=connector_poc_2024-06. We need those in logs to filter latency/cost.

mike-eng: Will attach labels to the service account and to the route.

ci-bot: Deployment scheduled for partner-sandbox at 2024-06-20T18:45:00Z :rocket:

anne-partnerships: Thanks — can you confirm by EOD that creds + demo seat are ready? @mike-eng

mike-eng: Yep, provisioning now. I'll post when done and DM the secure key. :thumbsup:

raj-snowflake: Once you post role details I'll run a quick ingest to validate COPY INTO + external stage.

anne-partnerships: Awesome. If anything blocks, drop it here or ping me directly.

ci-bot: Deployment started (job id: deploy-pt-4532)

mike-eng: Provisioned — sent the key via secure channel, created role partner_connector_demo_role, and applied the burst policy. I also attached labels. Running the sample embed check now.

tina-soleng: Confirmed embed check succeeded (vector returned, latency ~120ms). I'll kick off the full 1k doc run in 30m and report metrics.

anne-partnerships: Great, closing loop. We'll use these creds for next week's demo. :party_popper:
